name: 🍚 Kitchen-Sink Grain Bowls
tagline: A use-it-up bowl: a grain, a protein, two veggies, something crunchy and a great sauce.

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa, then simmer in 2 cups salted water, covered, 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork. (Or microwave the frozen brown rice.)
Shake the dressing in a jar until creamy.
Prep the toppings into little piles: tomatoes, cucumber, beans, cheese, protein.
Bowl it: grain on the bottom, toppings in sections on top.
Dress right before eating and finish with the crunchy seeds.

chef_tip: Formula, not recipe: grain + protein + 2 veggies + crunch + sauce. Whatever's in the fridge, it works.
make_ahead: Cook the quinoa on Sunday; it keeps 5 days. Dressing keeps a week.
leftovers: Pack dressing separately in a small cup for lunches.
swaps: Spring mix base instead of grain
heads_up: Check the fridge for leftovers to use.
